<solar/>Hellion projectiles deal up to 20% increased damage after traveling 17 meters.

<solar/>Hellion projectiles that have been in flight for 1 second release 4 pieces of Shrapnel with tracking capabilities.

Shrapnel projectiles deal <pve 18 /> <pvp [?] /> <solar/>Solar Damage and apply 5? stacks of <solar/>Scorch each.
